From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: SIG/CAIQ start — evidence map & hosting boundary question

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so your security team can triage: 

- Status check: you mentioned Sunrise is evaluating vendors for an outpatient triage assistant and need SOC 2 evidence + clarity on data residency (US-only) and HIPAA coverage.
- Recommendation: we typically start with a SIG/CAIQ prefilling (fastest route) and attach a short custom appendix for HIPAA-specific flows. If you require signed BAA language up front we can loop legal in parallel.
- Clarifying question for your ops/security team (need before we send prefill): do you consider our hosted API (regional US deployment) sufficient, or do you require a Dedicated/private deployment for evaluation? This changes evidence scope (network diagrams, VPC peering details).

I attached a short prefilling template that mirrors the CAIQ/SIG sections we usually handle and a network diagram stub to show the level of detail we can provide.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm whether Sunrise wants: CAIQ-prefill + HIPAA appendix OR a fully customized questionnaire.
2) If CAIQ-prefill, share a point-of-contact for evidence intake (email + preferred SFTP/Drive).
3) If Dedicated or private deployment is required, let us know desired timeline so we can include hosting diagrams and ops runbooks.

Happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up with your security lead — I can bring Ben (security intake) and Kim (hosting/ops). Are you available tomorrow at 15:00 PT?

Best,
David Kim
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-prefill-template.pdf (pdf, 85KB), redwood-network-diagram.png (png, 240KB)

From: Alice Morrell <alice.morrell@sunrisehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: security@sunrisehealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ start — evidence map & hosting boundary question

Thanks David — useful recap. A few immediate clarifications from our security team: 

- Preference: we'd like the CAIQ-prefill first (quicker), plus a HIPAA appendix that maps the questions to our specific workflows (PHI in transit and at rest).
- Hosting boundary: for evaluation it's acceptable to use Redwood hosted in US regions, but any PII/PHI export must be documented — if we move to a pilot with real patient data we will require Dedicated or VPC options.
- Timeline: target to complete initial intake within 2 weeks, ideally. Can you provide a one-page evidence map that lists which attachments you will provide (SOC 2 report, encryption configs, key rotation practices, KMS details, network diagrams) vs. items we should expect from our side?

Also — two quick questions for your intake process: 
1) Do you accept uploads via our secure SFTP?
2) Do you have a pre-signed DocuSign BAA template you can share, or is that handled after technical signoff?

I'll loop in our security operations inbox so they can assign an owner.

Best,
Alice Morrell
CTO (Acting)
Sunrise Health

Following up with the evidence map Alice requested — I've drafted the one-pager and attached it as 'RDW-evidence-map-Sunrise.pdf'. High level: 

- We can provide SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), our CAIQ-prefill (completed sections in the template you received), KMS key rotation policy, TLS config, and a regional network diagram for the US-hosted API.
- Items we will need from Sunrise: contact for SFTP, list of expected endpoints that will send PHI (so we can highlight those flows), and your preferred retention window if different from our default 30 days for transient logs (note: we support configurable retention on Dedicated).

Quick answers to your questions: 
1) Yes, we accept SFTP uploads. Provide host, user, and a PGP key and we'll spin up intake access.
2) We have a standard BAA template; I attached a DocuSign link for a draft execution if you want to start legal review in parallel. (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sandbox/example/rdw-baa-draft)

Proposed timeline: we can deliver CAIQ-prefill + evidence bundle within 4 business days after you confirm SFTP details and the list of PHI-producing endpoints. If you request Dedicated diagrams/ops runbook that adds ~3 business days.

Ben
Security Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
